about: Every kind of behaviour the survey has seen, each with what it is, how a law is placed in it at a size, and how it scores (the operator, 2026-11-24 10:22: "all behavior needs to have a list of this is a kind of behavior, this is how to spot it early, and this is how we score it"). How early and how reliably each is known is what `tools/catalogue_reading.py` reads on a bundle; this file holds only the definitions, and a new kind is a new entry.

rule.words: At a size, a chain reads its d (the median of its probes), its mean degree, its giant piece's share, its accepted moves per edge (the median over its seeds) and whether most of its seeds ended at the degree cap (full). On a twin start (empty or random) each probe also reads how many sizes in a row, from 4,096, its value steps within the score's own margin at that size. Two chains agree when their d and mean degree are each within agree_within of the other's, relative; a chain empty or full agrees with none. The law's kind at that size is the first that applies, in the order of `categories`.

categories.name: settled from empty or random
categories.what: a probe, any one, settles on a twin start, the chain grown from empty or from a random graph: the law makes a structure it was not given, whatever its d
categories.read: a probe, any one, on the empty or the random start steps within the score's margin at twin_settled_at_least sizes in a row, the highest read (4,096, 16,384 and 65,536), by its value alone; the score in force, whose reach rule may refuse it, is read beside it
categories.score: as the score in force; the kind the operator wants to know of first (2026-11-24 10:43)
categories.first_seen: study 174: 8 laws, every one one-dimensional by its probes (d 1.0 to 1.15); two of them, 18856793523d and 3a8569fc6094, grow from both twin starts one connected piece holding every node at mean degree 2.00. The score in force settles none of the 8: their reach grows as about d 2, so the piece is not a clean loop (a ring settles at full points among the score's known answers, criterion 5): those two are one loop with about 13 and 35 shortcuts at 65,536, every node on a cycle (853); four are open strings with no cycle, one is a loop with about 284 shortcuts, and 99e25674e37a is small cliques strung into strands

categories.name: made
categories.what: different starts arrive at the same d and mean degree, d at least ring_below: the law makes one geometry of more than one dimension, whatever it was given
categories.score: as the score in force; the kind the survey looks for (2026-11-24)
categories.first_seen: study 174, H31 (3931d03e8edf) at 16,384, d 4.0 at mean degree 26, its bcc and fcc starts

categories.name: ring or chain made
categories.what: different starts arrive at the same d below ring_below: one-dimensional structures, rings, chains and trees; told from made by the d they agree on, not by their mean degree
categories.read: two chains or more agree, their d below ring_below
categories.first_seen: the survey's first studies; 161 of the 168 laws of 174 whose starts agree from 4,096

categories.name: empty
categories.what: no chain grows past empty_at_most mean degree
categories.read: every chain at most empty_at_most mean degree

categories.name: full
categories.what: every chain that grows ends at the degree cap
categories.read: every chain past empty_at_most mean degree has full_share of its seeds or more ended at the cap

categories.name: frozen lattice
categories.what: a lattice start no move of the law ever changed: not one edge in any seed
categories.read: no two chains agree, and the lattice chains not full at their own degree, within degree_within, that accept at most still_at_most moves per edge accepted none

categories.name: still lattice
categories.what: a lattice start the law leaves nearly alone: it keeps its own mean degree and accepts moves on at most still_at_most of its edges, but some, while no other start arrives where it is
categories.read: no two chains agree, and a lattice chain not full reads within degree_within of its lattice's degree with at most still_at_most accepted moves per edge, more than none
categories.score: 1, the lowest (2026-11-24, widening the frozen lattice of 2026-11-21); a candidate beside the score in force until its criterion is judged

categories.name: rewired lattice
categories.what: a lattice start that keeps its mean degree but accepts many moves, so its shape may not be its lattice's
categories.read: no two chains agree, and a lattice chain not full reads within degree_within of its lattice's degree with more than still_at_most accepted moves per edge

categories.name: melted lattice
categories.what: lattice starts that leave their own mean degree, no two starts arriving at the same place
categories.read: no two chains agree, and a lattice chain not full reads, none within degree_within of its lattice's degree

categories.name: broken
categories.what: no chain keeps a piece of half the graph
categories.read: every chain's giant piece below broken_below of the graph

categories.name: apart
categories.what: starts read a d but end apart, none of them a lattice at its own degree
categories.read: a chain reads a d, no two agree, no lattice chain reads

categories.name: nothing read
categories.what: no chain reads a d at this size

not_read_here.name: stream
not_read_here.what: the law's own random numbers decide what it reads: the same law on new random numbers reads otherwise

not_read_here.name: tree of long paths
not_read_here.what: a tree whose branches are long paths settles at d 1.1 to 1.4 under the score, a random tree's spectral dimension being 4/3: a known limit
not_read_here.read: placed with rings by its d
